identity.title: Stabilize Runtime conversation cleanup-race admission and deadline semantics

values.task_boundary: Correct only the cleanup-race admission/deadline behavior introduced by PR #228.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Initial accepted acknowledgement does not wait for dispatch-gate or ingress completion.
AC-2: A new session generation cannot consume or inherit a stale predecessor deadline.
AC-3: Cleanup-race proof deterministically observes accepted, in-flight attachment, and exactly one delivered terminal result.
AC-4: Cancellation, timeout, ordering, capacity, and token-rotation semantics remain green.
AC-5: Required Runtime fast lane passes at the reviewed exact revision.
non_goals: Running optional CI or broad workspace validation
